findings.current:
So that was what he meant.

When he said something serious might happen, he had meant something genuinely serious.
findings.defect: The draft omits Taekyung’s profane reversal of his earlier affection, weakening both his voice and the punchline.
findings.rationale: 기특하긴 시벌 explicitly repudiates Taekyung’s thought that Hyuk Mujin was being endearing, with strong profanity, before continuing the 큰일 wordplay.
findings.replacement:
Endearing, my ass.

When he said something serious might happen, he’d meant a real emergency.
findings.source:
기특하긴 시벌.

큰일 날 것 같다고 한 게 진짜 큰일 말하는 거였네.

findings.current: Gung Gibang and I were momentarily left speechless. Hyuk Mujin wiped cold sweat from his brow and hurried to the front.
findings.defect: The draft adds a wiping action absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 식은땀을 흘리며 means he was sweating; it does not say that he wiped his brow.
findings.replacement: Gung Gibang and I were momentarily left speechless. Breaking out in a cold sweat, Hyuk Mujin hurried ahead.
findings.source: 순간 할 말을 잃어버린 나와 궁기방의 모습에, 혁무진이 식은땀을 흘리며 앞장서서 걸음을 옮겼다.

findings.current: “Then I’ll go first. Urrrrgh! I’m coming!”
findings.defect: The final cry is changed into an unrelated declaration. 응가 is childish language for poop, sustaining the bowel-emergency joke.
findings.rationale: 응가아아앗 is an elongated, childish cry about defecation, not “I’m coming.”
findings.replacement: “Urgh. Then I’m going on ahead. Poooooop!”

findings.current: “Pfft. I should’ve seen that bastard Hyuk’s face.”
findings.defect: The draft reverses the subject and object: Gung Gibang says Hyuk should have witnessed this scene, not that Gung should have seen Hyuk’s face.
findings.rationale: 혁가 놈이 is the understood subject of 봤어야 했는데, while 이 광경 is what he should have seen.
findings.replacement: “Pfft. That bastard Hyuk should’ve seen this.”
findings.source: “푸흐흐. 이 광경을 혁가 놈을 봤어야 했는데.”

findings.current: “How dare he! How dare that bastard tear me limb from limb……!”
findings.defect: The direction of the threat is reversed. Hwangbo Ak is calling the attacker a bastard he will tear apart, not saying that the attacker intends to tear him apart.
findings.rationale: 찢어 죽일 놈 is Hwangbo Ak’s threatening insult toward the other person: a bastard he wants to tear apart and kill.
findings.replacement: “How dare you… You bastard! I’ll tear you apart……!”

findings.current: Its tremendous power and speed were obvious from the sound alone. Even if he had been fully alert, dodging it would have been difficult. Since he had been distracted for a moment, the result was obvious.
findings.defect: The draft narrows the uncertain ability to withstand or handle the attack into difficulty specifically dodging it.
findings.rationale: 정신을 똑바로 차려도 될까 말까 does not specify dodging; it says that even with his full attention, successfully dealing with the attack would have been uncertain.
findings.replacement: Its tremendous power and speed were obvious from the sound of it cutting through the air alone. Even fully alert, he would have been hard-pressed to handle it. After letting himself get distracted, the outcome was obvious.
findings.source: 파공성만으로도 느껴지는 엄청난 힘과 속도. 정신을 똑바로 차려도 될까 말까인데, 잠시 한눈을 팔았으니 결과는 뻔했다.

findings.current: I clicked my tongue bitterly and glanced around.
findings.defect: The physical action is changed from smacking or wetting one’s lips to clicking one’s tongue.
findings.rationale: 입맛을 다시다 describes moving or smacking the lips, here with a bitter emotional nuance; it is not 혀를 차다, clicking the tongue.
findings.replacement: I smacked my lips bitterly and glanced around.
findings.source: 쓰게 입맛을 다신 나는 문득 주위를 둘러보았다.

summary: Two critical reversals alter who should have witnessed the scene and who threatens to tear whom apart. The draft also omits a profane punchline, mistranslates Hyuk Mujin’s childish exclamation, and introduces smaller action and combat-mechanism inaccuracies.
